categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Bosses are fought at the end of specific chapters, and so are impossible to miss.

categories.title: Locked Door
categories.info: Locked Doors can only be opened once you've obtained a Key. Any Key will open any Locked Door.

categories.title: Secret Door
categories.info: Hidden doors that you need to reveal by doing a specific action, such as using the Darklight or removing an obstacle.

categories.title: Boo
categories.info: Boos are ghosts that hide in an object that is only invisible in a specific chapter. You need to collect all Boos in a mansion to unlock its Bonus stage.

categories.title: Gem
categories.info: Gems are found by investigating objects or completing specific tasks. Collect all of a mansion's gems to unlock a crystal statue in the Vault.

categories.title: Key
categories.info: Keys can be used to unlock any Locked Door.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasure are sources of money, including Coins, Bills and Ingots. We only mark sources worth 40 Coins or more.

locations.title: Harsh Possessor
locations.description: Fought during B-Boss: Tree Topping

locations.title: The Three Sisters
locations.description: Fought during B-3: Graveyard Shift.

locations.title: Courtyard Locked Door
locations.description: Only locked in B-1: A Job for a Plumber.

locations.title: East Hall Strobulb Door
locations.description: Cannot be used in B-1: A Job for a Plumber.

locations.title: Gardener's Dwelling Dark-Light Door
locations.description: Reveal this door with the Dark-Light.

locations.title: MamBoo
locations.description: In B-1: A Job for a Plumber, use the Dark-Light to reveal a toolbox, then interact with it.

locations.title: Boolean
locations.description:
In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, vacuum this tongue-like ceiling plant to reveal Boolean.

In B-3: Graveyard Shift, this will have 60 Coins instead.

locations.title: Booluga
locations.description: Use the Dark-Light to reveal a pot on top of the stone pedestal.

locations.title: Boo B. Trap
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light at this empty spot on the wall to reveal Boo B.

locations.title: French Boodle
locations.description: During B-5: Doggone Key, you'll have to go through the Toolshed into the Garden. When you return to the Toolshed, all the objects will be gone! Reveal them with the Dark-Light to expose French Boodle.

locations.title: Emerald #1
locations.description: Under the stairs. To reach it, walk behind and left of the bottom of the stairs.

locations.title: Emerald #2
locations.description: Inside the glass container. To get in, use the balloons in this area to float up to the second level of the room. Float behind the tree in the back-left corner, then drop down to get to the Gem.

locations.title: Emerald #3
locations.description: Water the plant in the bottom-right corer, then flash it to get this Gem.

locations.title: Emerald #4
locations.description: BEFORE revealing the upper pipe section with the Dark-Light, instead use the Strobulb on the red machine on the left side of the room to fill a wooden bucket. Use the bucket on the plant in the back-right corner of the room, then flash it with the Strobulb to get this Gem.

locations.title: Emerald #5
locations.description: Use the potato gun in the middle of the room to shoot the mouse as it scurries through the plants and beakers in the back of the room.

locations.title: Emerald #6
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, head for the Tower Lobby and go up the stairs to the flowing water. Aim the Dark-Light above it to reveal some pipes. Now reveal the hidden door at the bottom of the stairs: use the spiked plant here to kill the Venus Flytrap guarding the Chest with this Emerald in it.

locations.title: Emerald #7
locations.description:
Use a ball of web and light it on fire to burn a web wall to where the Golden Spiders are. Grab the bucket in that area, then fill it with water using the pool of water. Use the bucket on the plant here, then flash it with the Strobulb to get this Emerald.

In B-5: Doggone Key, you don't have to burn down any spider webs!

locations.title: Emerald #8
locations.description: Look up at this spot to find this hanging from a vine: grab it with the Poltergust.

locations.title: Emerald #9
locations.description: During B-4: Pool Party, suck up this red flower to get the Gem.

locations.title: Emerald #10
locations.description: Run anti-clockwise around the doll to unscrew its head, revealing this Gem.

locations.title: Emerald #11
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light at the shaded spot on the table to reveal a Chest with the Emerald in it.

locations.title: Emerald #12
locations.description: In B-4: Pool Party, float up to this balcony from the organ. Head for the near side of the balcony and shine the Dark-Light on the wall to reveal a secret door. In this minigame, collect all the Red Coins to unlock a toolbox with this Emerald in it.

locations.title: Emerald #13
locations.description: Vacuum the roll of toilet paper to get this Gem.

locations.title: Haunted Towers Entrance Key / 65 Coins
locations.description:
In B-1: A Job for a Plumber, flash the right-hand flower with the Strobulb to get this Key.

In B-3: Graveyard Shift, water then flash this plant for 65 Coins.

locations.title: Hydro Generator Key
locations.description: In B-1: A Job for a Plumber, check inside the Chest.

locations.title: Plant Nursery Key
locations.description:
Kill the two Venus Flytraps with the spiked plant ball to access the chest containing this Key.

In B-4: Pool Party, shine the Dark-Light where this chest was to get 53 Coins.

locations.title: West Bedroom Key
locations.description: During B-4: Pool Party, vacuum the ceiling fan to reveal a Ghost Bed-finding minigame that awards this Key.

locations.title: Crow's Nest Key
locations.description: Reached during B-4: Pool Party. Shine the Dark-Light on the picture of a Key to get a real one.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description:
In B-1: A Job for a Plumber, vacuum the pile of dirt from the base of this tree, then interact with it to get 100 Coins.

In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, the tree will have a Golden Bat.

In B-3: Graveyard Shift, the tree will have two Golden Spiders.

In B-4: Pool Party, the tree with have a Golden Greenie inside.

In B-5: Doggone Key, it will only have a single Golden Frog.

locations.title: 200 G
locations.description:
In B-1: A Job for a Plumber, suck up all the ceiling vines to cause bills to rain down.

In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, this drops 200 Coins.

In B-3: Graveyard Shift, this drops 165 Coins.

In B-4: Pool Party, the vines will be replaced by red flowers, which will drop 200 Coins.

locations.title: 45 G
locations.description: Vacuum the large leaf on the window here to reveal a Golden Bat. It and the other bats in the room will give 45 Coins in total.

locations.title: 40 G
locations.description: In B-1: A Job for a Plumber, look for two gold ingots on the end of the wooden walkway on the second level.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: In B-1: A Job for a Plumber, check behind the goo machine.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: Suck up the golden balloon in this corner to make a line of Coins in the air. Float using the golden balloon, and if you can collect them all within the time limit and without popping the balloon, you'll spawn a Chest with more money!

locations.title: 50 G / 60 G
locations.description:
In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, water this flower with a bucket and then flash it with the Strobulb.

In B-3: Graveyard Shift, water and flash the same plant for 60 Coins.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, water these two flowers and then flash them with the Strobulb.

locations.title: 50 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, water this flower and then hit it with the Strobulb.

locations.title: 50 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, water this flower, then flash it with the Strobulb.

locations.title: 90 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, suck up the pile of dust in the corner of the courtyard, then water the plant grow a spiked ball plant. Next, use the Dark-Light to reveal a missing paving stone switch. Stand on the switch to reveal a ghost cut-out: shoot it with a spiked ball to spawn a Golden Greenie!

locations.title: 50 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, water this plant, then flash it.

locations.title: 50 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, water this plant, then flash it.

locations.title: 75 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, vacuum the wad of notes sitting on top of a shelf.

locations.title: 53 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, vacuum up the poster in the front-left corner of the room.

locations.title: 53 G
locations.description:
In B-2: The Pinwheel Door, use the Dark-Light on the rope railing to reveal a dresser with cash in it.

In B-5: Doggone Key, the dresser will have a Golden Greenie in it.

locations.title: 53 G
locations.description:
Inside a Chest in the back. The grate to the right of it has fake bars that you can vacuum, letting you get back here.

Found during B-2: The Pinwheel Gate and B-3: Graveyard Shift.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, vacuum the tongue-like ceiling plant.

locations.title: 80 G
locations.description: Shoot all the plants and beakers in the back of the room using the potato gun to cause four Gold Spiders to appear.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: Vacuum the poster on the small wall on the right-hand side.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, blow on the valve near this point to water these two plants, then flash for the cash.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In B-2: The Pinwheel Gate, water these two plants and then flash them.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: In B-3: Graveyard Shift, three Gold Mice appear in this room.

locations.title: 43 G
locations.description: In B-3: Graveyard Shift, open the coffin.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: During B-3: Graveyard Shift, open the coffin stood up on the wall to enter a minigame. Collect all Red Coins in the maze before time runs out to get the loot!

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: In B-3: Graveyard Shift, burn down the web wall, then flash the three Golden Spiders.

locations.title: 62 G
locations.description: In B-3: Graveyard Shift, tug on the green vine at this spot three times to get two spiders and then three Golden Spiders to appear.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: In B-3: Graveyard Shift, check behind the stone raven head elevator for three Gold Ingots.

locations.title: 110 G
locations.description: In B-3: Graveyard Shift, blow out all the candles on this crypt to reveal a Golden Greenie, and check the back-right corner of the crypt for a Gold Ingot

locations.title: 53 G
locations.description: In B-3: Graveyard Shift, vacuum the green sheet of moss in the back-left corner.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In B-4: Pool Party, reveal a coathanger at this spot with the Dark-Light, then suck up the coat and all six curtains in the room.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: During B-4: Pool Party, float up from the organ to this balcony. Suck up the gold balloon and follow the Coin path to a chest.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In B-5: Doggone Key, blow the ceiling fan to get this cash.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In B-5: Doggone Key, vacuum up the blankets on all three beds.

locations.title: 73 G
locations.description: In B-5: Doggone Key, reveal the missing toilet with the Dark-Light.
